_comment: iCal (.ics) feeds pulled by scripts/ingest.ts — structured data, no scraping or AI. Only feeds confirmed to return real ICS belong here; the other CivicEngage cities are covered by the per-event scraper in scripts/scrapers.ts (Calendar.aspx -> iCalendar.aspx?EID=n). A wrong URL just yields 0 events (logged), never breaks the run.
